episode_summary: Hashing It Out interview (June 2024) with Kieran Mesquita, a Railgun contributor. Railgun adds a private 0zk address type on Ethereum; they explain shielding, private balances and DeFi use, relayers that let users pay gas in any token over Waku, why Railgun stays fully on-chain rather than using a rollup, gas costs as the main pain point, the Powers of Tau setup and Groth16 proofs, and the DAO treasury and governance. Frank also takes part in the discussion.

cards.claim: In June 2024 Kieran Mesquita said Railgun had launched about three years earlier, going on four, with its DAO running from almost day one.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: but it's been launched about three years ago going on four soon it's been running strong since then DAO from pretty much day one

cards.claim: Kieran Mesquita described Railgun as a protocol that adds a new private address type to Ethereum, alongside public 0x addresses.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: is just a protocol that adds like a new um address type to ethereum right

cards.claim: Kieran Mesquita explained that shielding moves tokens from a public wallet into a private balance represented as a UTXO, which only the key holder can view.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: that's an action called a shield um and essentially what that does is it just takes um you know the the tokens from a public wallet

cards.claim: Kieran Mesquita said Railgun is geared towards a private address rather than hiding transaction amounts, with its main use being private balances for DeFi.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: so Railgun is really geared towards being a private address rather than anything else

cards.claim: Kieran Mesquita described a long-term trading strategy run from a private Railgun balance, so that others cannot see and copy the positions.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: if you had a long-term trading strategy, you didn't want anybody obviously to see what you're doing because, you know, it's your strategy

cards.claim: In June 2024 Kieran Mesquita said that trading strategies run in public get figured out within days and lose their edge.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: if you've, like, spent a lot of effort developing this kind of alpha, right, if you, like, go and do it in public, like, that stuff's going to be, like, figured out within days

cards.claim: In June 2024 Kieran Mesquita said Vitalik was using Railgun to move ETH out of his very public vitalik.eth address.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: you've got like vitalik using it uh to to move eth out of his uh very public vitalik.eth e and s address

cards.claim: In June 2024 Kieran Mesquita recounted a trader whose strategy FTX was counter-trading, which he said turned out badly because FTX was not trustworthy.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: they were like well when ftx was still thing you know um they were like counter trading them

cards.claim: Kieran Mesquita explained that Railgun relayers let a user pay gas in any token that a relayer accepts, because the relayer is paid in that token.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: You can effectively pay for for gas using whatever token you want

cards.claim: Kieran Mesquita said relayers communicate over the Waku peer-to-peer network, which is how Railgun transactions get broadcast.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: that's something that's called a relayer, right? And actually, you know, since we're on this podcast really is communicate over the Waku network.

cards.claim: In June 2024 Kieran Mesquita said anyone can run a relayer that follows the specification, and a reference implementation is available.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: And there is a reference implementation that people can run as well.

cards.claim: In June 2024 Kieran Mesquita predicted relayer competition would become a race to the bottom, won by whoever writes the best logic for the cheapest gas.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: whoever can write the best logic to provide the cheapest gas while still breaking even

cards.claim: In June 2024 Kieran Mesquita said Railgun was already deployed on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon and BNB.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: there's a couple of um chains that that we've gone is already deployed on that's ethereum uh arbitram polygon uh bnb

cards.claim: Kieran Mesquita explained that new Railgun chain deployments are approved through an on-chain DAO vote that also deploys the contracts when passed.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: So that's a completely like on-chain voting process to say, okay, deploy on whatever chain.

cards.claim: Kieran Mesquita compared three options for privacy on Ethereum and said Railgun chose to deploy entirely on-chain, with no rollup, bridge or sequencer.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: And then there's a railgun approach, which is just deploy entirely on-chain, right? So there's no roll-up, there's no bridge,

cards.claim: In June 2024 Kieran Mesquita said the number one pain point with using Railgun was gas cost.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: I think the number one kind of pain point right now with using Railgun is probably the gas cost

cards.claim: In June 2024 Kieran Mesquita said Arbitrum was probably the cheapest chain on which to use Railgun.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: I think Arbitrum is probably the place that you could use Railgun the cheapest right now.

cards.claim: Kieran Mesquita described the Powers of Tau ceremony as a public-good setup, run for Ethereum, that produced the phase one parameters for the Railgun circuits.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: Powers of Tau ceremony, which is what was used for like the phase one of the circuit setup for uh realcom

cards.claim: Kieran Mesquita said the trusted setup holds as long as at least one contributor did not collude with everyone else.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: or like at least one person doesn't uh collude with everyone else

cards.claim: Kieran Mesquita said Groth16 was used because it was by far the most efficient proof scheme to verify on Ethereum.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: the reason that Grot16 is used is because it's the most efficient

cards.claim: In June 2024 Kieran Mesquita said Zcash had moved to Halo 2.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: I know Zcash has Halo 2 now.

cards.claim: Kieran Mesquita said a relayer could save gas by submitting several relayed transactions in one transaction, since Ethereum storage costs favour batching.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: if you submit multiple relayed transactions in a single transaction, you will actually save on gas

cards.claim: In June 2024 Kieran Mesquita said he did not foresee centralisation emerging in Railgun, because almost everything is pushed on-chain.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: So I don't think, I don't foresee any sort of centralization happening.

cards.claim: Kieran Mesquita described Railgun as a private address standard, where a user's transaction history stays viewable with the private key or an exported view key.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: Railgun is a private address standard, right? And so part of that is you've still got a transaction history and all of this that's viewable with your private key.

cards.claim: Kieran Mesquita said the planned Railgun V3 is an evolution of the architecture, still largely inspired by Zcash's Sapling design.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: It still, I think at its core, is very inspired by Zcash's sapling.

cards.claim: Kieran Mesquita described Railgun Connect as a way to use any DApp front end through Railgun without a specific integration, as if using MetaMask.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: essentially it's a method of being able to use pretty much any like DAP front end through Railgun without like having to have a specific integration

cards.claim: In June 2024 Kieran Mesquita said a proportion of the Railgun DAO treasury balance is paid out to active governors through proposals, acting as a smoothing buffer for stakers.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: a proportion of the current balance of the the treasury um goes out to um

cards.claim: In June 2024 Kieran Mesquita said the Railgun DAO has no admin keys and that governance executes the actual contract actions on chain.
cards.speaker: Kieran Mesquita
cards.quote: no admin keys and everything that's voted on, all of that happens on chain

title: Kieran Mesquita | Railgun Transactional Privacy Protection
